cases.title: Web purchase appears in the same account in the app
cases.expected: One server-confirmed purchase creates the correct parent and dated occurrence, visible to its verified owner across both interfaces.

cases.title: Configured first and regular prices on all active offers
cases.expected: Rahu 51/121, Gaj Mahalakshmi 51/101 and Triyuginarayan 51/151 examples retain the correct product identity, cadence and purchase snapshot.

cases.title: Two beneficiaries and unknown gotra policy
cases.expected: Account holder, payer and beneficiary are distinct; names and gotra remain attributable on every occurrence and old evidence.

cases.title: Failed date followed by successful next-date retry
cases.expected: The missed occurrence stays discontinued; successful retry registers the provider/operations-confirmed next eligible date without a false progress increment.

cases.title: Independent evidence readiness and recovery
cases.expected: A ready certificate or video is immediately available while another asset prepares or fails; overdue support keeps the occurrence reference.

cases.title: Milestone and mandate continuity
cases.expected: Configured milestone completion retains the total, keeps the mandate active and creates no separate milestone certificate.

cases.title: Legacy purchase and cancellation synchronization
cases.expected: Existing terms are preserved; cancellation does not falsely become Active during sync; the fate of an already paid upcoming occurrence follows the agreed policy.

cases.title: Checkout return and notification destinations
cases.expected: Installed, uninstalled, signed-out, pending and interrupted states open the correct authorized record or browser fallback without inventing payment success.
